content.short: ISME is a DID System and Social Explorer powered by the Root Protocol.
content.description: ISME introduces a novel identifier designed to support verifiable, decentralized digital identity, with the ambition of uniting everything within the first unified social identity network. This approach enables users to connect with others while the system surfaces the mutual experiences they share, making those commonalities more visible and easier to explore. In doing so, ISME seeks to create a cohesive, interconnected social identity that traverses various contexts and communities across Web3.
